cohort: US population, using 2010 birth certificate data and Medicare claims data
finding: Cesarean delivery rates were positively correlated with total Medicare spending and hospital use in the last 6 months of life, suggesting that variation in cesarean delivery rates across US communities is correlated with broader health care usage patterns.
mod_finding: This study examines the variation in cesarean delivery rates across US communities, finding a correlation with broader healthcare usage patterns, but does not focus on specific modes of delivery.
